description:
Long-Range Samsung Battery

Equipped with a high-capacity 48V 18Ah Samsung lithium battery, this city eBike offers an impressive range of 80–150 km on a single charge. The removable battery features a built-in lock for theft prevention, allowing you to charge it conveniently at home or in the office.

Powerful 250W Motor with 60Nm Torque

The 250W brushless motor delivers strong acceleration and climbing ability, providing up to 60Nm of torque while staying fully compliant with EU road regulations. Paired with 26×3.0" puncture-resistant tyres, this electric bike offers stable performance on city streets, gravel paths, and light off-road trails. Three pedal assist levels help you ride with ease, with a maximum assisted speed of 25 km/h.

Smart APP Display

The centrally mounted display shows speed, battery level, and remaining range at a glance. Easily switch pedal assist levels or turn lights on/off using handlebar controls. With Bluetooth connectivity, you can pair your smartphone to control power, lighting, and assist levels directly through the app.

Step-Thru Frame for Easy Access

Designed with a lightweight yet durable aluminium step-thru frame, the BK16 city eBike makes mounting and dismounting effortless. The integrated front and rear lights, along with reflective wheel strips, enhance visibility and safety during day and night rides.

Designed for Comfort and Safety

Ergonomic geometry, reliable braking, and a sturdy build ensure a comfortable and secure riding experience. Whether commuting, running errands, or exploring the city, the BK16 electric bike is built to meet your everyday cycling needs.

Additional Information:

The HITWAY BK16 is available in Standard Version (non-Samsung battery, 48V 18Ah, range 70–120 km, no APP function) and APP Version (Samsung battery, 48V 18Ah, range 80–150 km). Choose the version that best suits your needs. This product arrives partially pre-assembled, with installation instructions and a step-by-step video provided. This model does not include a throttle and is fully compliant with EU eBike regulations.
